note: Supplemental, worker-authored repairs for host routing into editorial application with a separate reviewer. Not part of the closed-schema identity reports and not applied here. Applying any of them, or the record/chronology corrections, makes the current extraction, date and identity approvals stale under the normal gates.

translationRepairs.before: The inner attendant Yang Xilang, a collateral descendant of the former army supervisor Fu Gong, cited this precedent to claim Fu Gong's former estates.
translationRepairs.after: The inner attendant Yang Xilang, a collateral descendant of the former army supervisor Fugong, cited this precedent to claim Fugong's former estates.
translationRepairs.reason: 復恭 is one given name, written as Fuguang (復光) is in s0043; splitting it as "Fu Gong" misreads it as surname plus name. Consistency repair.

translationRepairs.before: The inner attendant Yang Xilang was the collateral descendant of the former Army Supervisor Fu Gong, and cited precedent to claim Fu Gong's former estates.
translationRepairs.after: The inner attendant Yang Xilang was the collateral descendant of the former Army Supervisor Fugong, and cited precedent to claim Fugong's former estates.
translationRepairs.reason: 復恭 is one given name, written as Fuguang (復光) is in s0043; splitting it as "Fu Gong" misreads it as surname plus name. Consistency repair.

translationRepairs.before: When the matter reached the Secretariat, Guangyun said to Guo Chongtao, "Fu Gong conspired in rebellion with the Shannan faction and plainly deserved punishment under the law. Our dynasty has not yet cleared his name—how can his estates be claimed?"
translationRepairs.after: When the matter reached the Secretariat, Guangyun said to Guo Chongtao, "Fugong conspired in rebellion with the Shannan faction and plainly deserved punishment under the law. Our dynasty has not yet cleared his name—how can his estates be claimed?"
translationRepairs.reason: 復恭 is one given name, written as Fuguang (復光) is in s0043; splitting it as "Fu Gong" misreads it as surname plus name. Consistency repair.

translationRepairs.before: The matter was sent down to the Secretariat, and Guangyun said to Chongyao, "Fu Gong plotted rebellion with Shannan and clearly deserved the national law; the present dynasty has not yet cleared his name—how can his case be argued?"
translationRepairs.after: The matter was sent down to the Secretariat, and Guangyun said to Chongtao, "Fugong plotted rebellion with Shannan and clearly deserved the national law; the present dynasty has not yet cleared his name—how can his case be argued?"
translationRepairs.reason: 郭崇韜: 韜 is tāo; the record's own pinyin is Guō Chóngtāo and accepted idiomatic repairs r0004/r0005/r0007 already read Chongtao. 復恭 is one given name, written as Fuguang (復光) is in s0043; splitting it as "Fu Gong" misreads it as surname plus name. Consistency repair.

translationRepairs.before: Chongyao privately restrained the eunuch and therefore submitted a full report to the throne.
translationRepairs.after: Chongtao privately restrained the eunuch and therefore submitted a full report to the throne.
translationRepairs.reason: 郭崇韜: 韜 is tāo; the record's own pinyin is Guō Chóngtāo and accepted idiomatic repairs r0004/r0005/r0007 already read Chongtao.

translationRepairs.before: Xilang argued: "My grand-uncle Fuguang rendered great service to the throne. My elder grand-uncle Fu Gong was framed by Zhang Jun and fell afoul of the former dynasty, when powerful ministers constrained the throne and imperial orders could not be enforced. After Wang Xingyu was executed, an edict of grace publicly cleared the record, and that edict still survives. Your Excellency is a hereditary minister of our dynasty and well versed in precedent—how can you say his name has not been cleared!
translationRepairs.after: Xilang argued: "My grand-uncle Fuguang rendered great service to the throne. My elder grand-uncle Fugong was framed by Zhang Jun and fell afoul of the former dynasty, when powerful ministers constrained the throne and imperial orders could not be enforced. After Wang Xingyu was executed, an edict of grace publicly cleared the record, and that edict still survives. Your Excellency is a hereditary minister of our dynasty and well versed in precedent—how can you say his name has not been cleared!
translationRepairs.reason: 復恭 is one given name, written as Fuguang (復光) is in s0043; splitting it as "Fu Gong" misreads it as surname plus name. Consistency repair.

translationRepairs.before: Xilang stated his appeal: "My grand-uncle Fuguang rendered great merit to the royal house; my elder-uncle Fu Gong was framed by Zhang Jun and offended the former dynasty. At the time powerful ministers checked the throne and the national command did not prevail. When Wang Xingyu was executed, an edict of grace publicly cleared the record and the edict still exists. Your Excellency is a hereditary clan of the present dynasty and well versed in precedent—how can you say his name has not been cleared!
translationRepairs.after: Xilang stated his appeal: "My grand-uncle Fuguang rendered great merit to the royal house; my elder grand-uncle Fugong was framed by Zhang Jun and offended the former dynasty. At the time powerful ministers checked the throne and the national command did not prevail. When Wang Xingyu was executed, an edict of grace publicly cleared the record and the edict still exists. Your Excellency is a hereditary clan of the present dynasty and well versed in precedent—how can you say his name has not been cleared!
translationRepairs.reason: 伯祖 is elder grand-uncle (paired with 叔祖 "grand-uncle"), not "elder-uncle". 復恭 is one given name, written as Fuguang (復光) is in s0043; splitting it as "Fu Gong" misreads it as surname plus name. Consistency repair.

translationRepairs.before: Zhang Quanyi spoke to Guo Chongyao about restoring him as chief minister; soon afterward he entered court as Guest of the Heir Apparent.
translationRepairs.after: Zhang Quanyi spoke to Guo Chongtao about restoring him as chief minister; soon afterward he entered court as Guest of the Heir Apparent.
translationRepairs.reason: 郭崇韜: 韜 is tāo; the record's own pinyin is Guō Chóngtāo and accepted idiomatic repairs r0004/r0005/r0007 already read Chongtao.

translationRepairs.before: His son You, in the Taiping Xingguo era, served as Regular Gentleman.
translationRepairs.after: His son Gou, in the Taiping Xingguo era, served as a bureau director (zhenglang).
translationRepairs.reason: 遘 is Gou (accepted repair r0010 and the idiomatic field); 正郎 is a bureau director, as the idiomatic field renders it.

translationRepairs.before: He was known from youth for filial devotion. After passing the jinshi examination he began as an inspector in the Revenue Bureau and magistrate of Weinan, served in the Historiography Institute, passed through three central offices, and under the Liang rose through director of the left department, magistrate of Wannian, and supervising secretary to vice minister of war.
translationRepairs.after: He was known from youth for filial devotion. After passing the jinshi examination he began as an inspector in the Revenue Bureau and captain of Weinan County, served in the Historiography Institute, passed through three central offices, and under the Liang rose through director of the left department, magistrate of Wannian, and supervising secretary to vice minister of war.
translationRepairs.reason: 渭南尉 is the county captain (尉), not the magistrate (令); compare 武功縣尉 "captain of Wugong County" in s0138 and 萬年令 "magistrate" in this same unit.

translationRepairs.before: From youth he had filial conduct; he passed the jinshi examination, took his first office as inspector of the Revenue Bureau and magistrate of Weinan, served directly in the Historiography Institute, passed through three offices, entered Liang as Director of the Left Department, magistrate of Wannian, and Supervising Secretary, and was repeatedly promoted to Vice Minister of War.
translationRepairs.after: From youth he had filial conduct; he passed the jinshi examination, took his first office as inspector of the Revenue Bureau and captain of Weinan County, served directly in the Historiography Institute, passed through three offices, entered Liang as Director of the Left Department, magistrate of Wannian, and Supervising Secretary, and was repeatedly promoted to Vice Minister of War.
translationRepairs.reason: 渭南尉 is the county captain (尉), not the magistrate (令).

translationRepairs.before: Earlier, when Doulu Ge and Wei Yue offended and were punished, the administration discussed appointing a chief minister. Privy Council Commissioner Kong Xun's intent was not to let a man of the Hebei-Shandong region hold the chief minister's seat; Ren Yuan wished to make Li Qi chief minister, but Zheng Jue had long been at odds with Qi, and Kong Xun also detested Qi. He said to An Chonghui, "Li Qi is not without learning and skill, but he is not incorrupt.
translationRepairs.after: Earlier, when Doulu Ge and Wei Yue offended and were punished, the administration discussed appointing a chief minister. Privy Council Commissioner Kong Xun's intent was not to let a man from the region north of the Yellow River hold the chief minister's seat; Ren Yuan wished to make Li Qi chief minister, but Zheng Jue had long been at odds with Qi, and Kong Xun also detested Qi. He said to An Chonghui, "Li Qi is not without learning and skill, but he is not incorrupt.
translationRepairs.reason: 河朔 is the region north of the Yellow River (as the idiomatic field renders it); it does not include Shandong.

translationRepairs.before: He had three sons—Ji, Song, and Shouzhen. Only Song served the present dynasty, rising to left remonstrating censor-in-chief and ending his career as acting military commissioner of Fu Prefecture.
translationRepairs.after: He had three sons—Qi, Song, and Shouzhen. Only Song served the present dynasty, rising to left remonstrating censor and ending his career as military adjutant (xingjun sima) of Fu Prefecture.
translationRepairs.reason: 頎 is qí. 左諫議大夫 is the remonstrating official rendered "remonstrating censor" in s0116, not a censor-in-chief; 行軍司馬 is the military adjutant, not an acting military commissioner.

translationRepairs.before: His sons Ji, Song, and Shouzhen—only Song served the present dynasty, reaching Left Remonstrating Censor-in-Chief, and ending as Acting Military Commissioner of Fu Prefecture.
translationRepairs.after: His sons Qi, Song, and Shouzhen—only Song served the present dynasty, reaching Left Remonstrating Censor, and ending as Military Adjutant of Fu Prefecture.
translationRepairs.reason: 頎 is qí; 左諫議大夫 is not a censor-in-chief; 行軍司馬 is the military adjutant.

translationRepairs.before: Jingfang's son Gu, during the Guangming era, served as judge on the military commission staff of Duke of Jin Wang Duo and, for his part in the recovery campaign, was made remonstrating censor.
translationRepairs.after: Jingfang's son Hu, during the Guangming era, served as judge on the military commission staff of Duke of Jin Wang Duo and, for his part in the recovery campaign, was made remonstrating censor.
translationRepairs.reason: 縠 is hú (record c0332 pinyin Hu); "Gu" is a misreading and collides with unrelated Li Gu (李固/李穀).

translationRepairs.before: Jingfang's son Gu, in Guangming, served as judge of the military commission under Duke of Jin Wang Duo, and for merits in recovery was made Remonstrating Censor.
translationRepairs.after: Jingfang's son Hu, in Guangming, served as judge of the military commission under Duke of Jin Wang Duo, and for merits in recovery was made Remonstrating Censor.

translationRepairs.before: Qi was Gu's son. At thirteen his rhapsodies, poems, and eulogies greatly impressed Wang Duo, though Duo also suspected that someone else was writing them for him.
translationRepairs.after: Qi was Hu's son. At thirteen his rhapsodies, poems, and eulogies greatly impressed Wang Duo, though Duo also suspected that someone else was writing them for him.

translationRepairs.before: Qi was precisely Gu's son; at age thirteen his rhapsodies, poems, and eulogies were greatly known by Wang Duo, yet he also suspected ghostwriting.

translationRepairs.before: One day Duo summoned Gu to a banquet at his headquarters and secretly sent someone to Qi's home with the topic 'Rhapsody on the Han Ancestor Obtaining the Three Outstanding Men.' Qi took up his brush and finished the piece on the spot.

translationRepairs.before: The next year he entered mourning for his mother, and thus wandered in Liu, Qi, and Lu.
translationRepairs.after: The next year he entered mourning for his mother, and thus sojourned in Qi and Lu.
translationRepairs.reason: 流寓 means to sojourn away from home; it is not a place "Liu". The idiomatic field already reads Qi and Lu only.

translationRepairs.before: At the beginning of Tianfu, he responded to the Broad Learning and Eminent Rhetoric examination, placed in the fourth rank, appointed Wei Gong County Captain, recruited as transport circuit inspector, promoted to Left Remonstrating Official and Palace Remonstrating Censor.
translationRepairs.after: At the beginning of Tianfu, he responded to the Broad Learning and Eminent Rhetoric examination, placed in the fourth rank, appointed Wugong County Captain, recruited as transport circuit inspector, promoted to Left Remonstrating Official and Palace Remonstrating Censor.
translationRepairs.reason: 武功 is Wugong County (idiomatic "captain of Wugong County").

translationRepairs.before: When Qi was handling Minister of Personnel examination matters with provisional title, he changed 'provisional' to 'acting'; reported by Qing, Liang Emperor greatly angry, about to banish to remote frontier, but rescued by Zhao Yan and others—dismissed from chancellor, made Crown Prince Junior Tutor.
translationRepairs.after: When Qi was issuing an appointment carrying a probationary acting title, he changed 'acting' to 'holding the post'; reported by Qing, Liang Emperor greatly angry, about to banish to remote frontier, but rescued by Zhao Yan and others—dismissed from chancellor, made Crown Prince Junior Tutor.
translationRepairs.reason: 除吏是試攝名銜，改「攝」為「守」: Li Qi was issuing an appointment whose title was probationary acting (試攝) and altered 攝 "acting" to 守 "holding the post". It does not mention the Minister of Personnel, and it mistranslates both characters.

translationRepairs.before: Before the eras of Xuanyuan and Huangdi the record cannot be traced in detail.

translationRepairs.reason: 軒黃 abbreviates 軒轅黃帝, a single ruler (Xuanyuan is the Yellow Emperor's name); the current English presents two people.

translationRepairs.before: Before Xuanyuan and Huangdi, cannot be recorded in detail.

translationRepairs.before: Later Han during Emperor An, flood drought insufficient, Three Excellencies memorialized request—wealthy entering grain could obtain within-the-passes marquis and various officials below Three Excellencies honorary posts.

translationRepairs.after: Previously, Zhang Jun from Secretariat went out as Right Vice Director; Liang Founder's judge Gao Shao had Liang Founder's yin seek one son's initial-office appointment—all the capital ministries and courts said no precedent; Jun bent rules to execute it, order extremely urgent, clerks terrified.
